title: death
summary: MSUI implements the current build-5875 death family: empty repop/corpse-query requests; strict corpse-query, reclaim-delay, length-prefixed resurrect-offer, spirit-healer-confirm, and empty durability-warning responses; plus exact full-GUID reclaim/healer and GUID-plus-accept resurrection bodies.

openItems.text: MSG_CORPSE_QUERY: absent entirely (no empty-body request, no found/not-found response parse) - no corpse marker, and the unprompted bones-conversion not-found push is dropped
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: MSG_CORPSE_QUERY sends an empty body, strictly accepts only the 1-byte absent or 21-byte found response, clears on the unprompted not-found push, and feeds both corpse markers and recovery range.

openItems.text: SMSG_SPIRIT_HEALER_CONFIRM: absent (no handler for the gossip-driven spirit-healer confirm guid)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: opcode 0x0222 is strictly parsed as one full healer GUID and drives the two-step XP-loss confirmation before CMSG_SPIRIT_HEALER_ACTIVATE.
